Name: Wizard Complete Portraits Compatible with Romanceable Rasmodius
Author: VocaFan4ever
Description:
Hi! I stumbled upon 2 portraits drawn by Chaekal-Rizum. But I really wanted a complete set to make it usable for the Romanceable Rasmodius mod! So here you gooo

To make it work with the Romanceable Rasmodius mod:
1. Go to wherever you installed the romance mod. It's usually C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Romanceable Rasmodius-3073-1-3-6-1610927501\[CP] Romanceable Rasmodius\assets
2. Replace the VanillaWizard.png file with this portrait instead. (You can also back up the original one if you want)
3. That's it!

If you were looking for sprites: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226
